The first bridge, (pictures 1 – 45) is part of the Canadian freeway QEW (Queen Elizabeth Way), crossing a river and “Oakwood Drive” in Niagara Falls, Ontario, Canada. The second bridge (picture 46) crosses the river Amstel inside the City of Amsterdam, Netherlands. The structural steel and concrete of the Canadian bridge are in a state of corrosion. candidats.titre: File:Homeless squatters, going largely unnoticed, under an expressway on ramp, near Simcoe Street, 2023 05 28 (52933984861).jpg
candidats.description: Homeless squatters, going largely unnoticed, under an expressway on ramp, near Simcoe Street. That white paint is not grafitti. Rebar corrosion, due to winter salt, represents a constant maintenance nightmare. Although years were spent patching visible scars in the concrete, due to corrosion, less than a decade ago, city workers have used white paint to mark new scars. What does it mean when a homeless person has their own e-bike?
